title: Axial Seamount eruption / inflation / forecast row
description: One row in the Axial Seamount chronology. Multi-row-type catalogue: 'eruption' for confirmed eruptive events (year + month + day + Julian date + caldera-floor subsidence); 'inflation_phase' for inter-eruption inflation phases (start_year + end_year + mean inflation rate); 'forecast' for published Chadwick-Nooner forecasts (issued_year + target window + outcome HIT/MISS/OPEN). Fields are union-typed by row_type; non-applicable fields are null.

row_type.description: Three values in this multi-row-type catalogue: 'eruption' / 'inflation_phase' / 'forecast'.

approximate_day.description: Day-of-month of eruption onset (eruption rows only).

julian_date.description: JD_TDB at eruption onset (eruption rows only).

caldera_floor_subsidence_m.description: Observed deflation in metres (eruption rows only).

start_year.description: Inflation phase start year (inflation_phase rows only).

end_year.description: Inflation phase end year (inflation_phase rows only).

mean_inflation_rate_cm_per_yr.description: Mean caldera-floor uplift rate in cm/yr (inflation_phase rows only).

issued_year.description: Year the Chadwick-Nooner forecast was issued (forecast rows only).

target_start_year.description: Forecast target window start year (forecast rows only).

target_end_year.description: Forecast target window end year (forecast rows only).

outcome.description: Forecast outcome — HIT if eruption occurred within window, MISS if not, OPEN if still active (forecast rows only).

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — observation provenance, methodology context, etc.

source_doi.description: DOI of the cited reference. 'nodoi:' prefix accepted for non-Crossref-indexed sources (e.g., 'nodoi:nooner_chadwick_post_2015' for post-2015 follow-up conference proceedings + OOI Cabled Array status updates).

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date for the cited source.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For dataset/program release tags when applicable.
